what: When the hero’s header nav leaves the screen, a floating pill nav at bottom center appears in .3s, and hides again once the footer enters the screen — rather than shrinking and moving the header nav, a second panel holding the same menu is added

options.after: Shows when this leaves the screen (selector), default header
options.until: Hides when this enters the screen (selector), default footer · ”none” keeps it floating to the end
options.look: sink: Instead of fading, it sinks down by 200% of its own height and hides (translate property). --fx-dur defaults to .7s, hiding uses --fx-ease (default power2.out), and returning uses --fx-ease-show (default power2.inOut). Brand bottom button.
options.after: none: Floats from the start without looking at the head (only the tail is seen)
options.at: Triggered by scroll amount instead of the header — it appears after scrolling this many px. Brand booking notice panel at: 10 (--fx-dur .6s · --fx-ease cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1))
options.look: edge: On wide screens it slides in from outside the right edge (translate 100% 0), at 767 and below from outside the bottom (0 100%), while becoming darker — --fx-dur defaults to .48s · --fx-ease defaults to ease. Because it uses the translate property, it does not mix with vertical centering (transform -50%) (Brand’s fixed right-side tab · phone bottom strip)

use: <nav data-fx="dock-reveal" data-fx-dock-reveal="after: .site-head; until: .site-foot" style="position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:20px;margin:auto;width:fit-content">…</nav> — Placement (fixed, centered) is left to the consumer
note: Inside a scroll panel (data-fx-scroller) it is measured against that panel. The original uses the same rule on subpages, so on a screen with no header it floats from the start

from.where: shared.js .dg-pill (floating-nav) — appears when the top nav disappears and hides when the footer comes in · opacity/visibility .3s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1)

shared.js .mm-fixnav (hours · booking fixed bottom button) — always floating, sinks by yPercent 200 in .7s power2.out when the footer enters, and returns in .7s power2.inOut when it leaves — after: none; look: sink

shared.js .kw-follow (bottom-right booking info panel) — appears after scrolling down more than 10px and hides when the footer touches the bottom of the screen, opacity · visibility .6s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1) — at: 10; until: #footer

shared.js .yo-side (vertical tabs for hours · access — original: is-shown once the hero (.js-mv, rootMargin top 50%) leaves view, removed when the Contact · footer group is visible. On phones, a bottom bar with four cells: phone · booking · hours · access)
